mpmToolbox.gui.msmEditingTools

Class MsmEditingTools

  • java.lang.Object
    • mpmToolbox.gui.msmEditingTools.MsmEditingTools

  • public class MsmEditingTools
extends java.lang.Object
    Helper class for MsmTreeNode. It generates the context menu that appears when right clicking in the MSM tree and all functionality required for it.

      • quickOpenEditor

        public static void quickOpenEditor(@NotNull
                                   MsmTreeNode forThisNode,
                                   @NotNull
                                   MsmTree inThisMsmTree)
        Invoke this method to immediately open the editor dialog of MSM nodes ... at least those that have an editor dialog and are leaf nodes in the MSM tree. Non-leaf nodes expand on double click and that is what this method is meant to be used for, open the editor on double click.
